text:
elaine (pm): FYI dropped a rough 'routing supply-chain' onramp doc here — https://redwood.share/doc/routing-supplychain-onramp :eyes: Please skim; need prioritization from product + engineering by EOW.

miguel (eng): reading now. quick Q — are we treating Dedicated customers as first-class for regional affinity or deferring to a later wave?

elaine (pm): Dedicated gets runway for Q3 pilot, but need clear launch guardrails: SLOs, failover behavior, and billing contract implications. adding checklists in the doc.

samir (arch): Suggestion: two-tier routing policy. Tier A = Dedicated + high-SLA customers (strict affinity, reserved capacity). Tier B = Hosted/default (best-effort affinity + cross-region fallback). Want to capture fallthrough rules and compatible-model mapping.

nina (sre): Also need operational playbook. For canary we should require: 5% traffic, 15 min health stable, latency P95 within 1.5x baseline, automatic rollback on error-rate >0.5%. I'll paste a minimal runbook snippet we can iterate on.

nina (sre): ```runbook: canary-start -> monitor latency,p99,error-rate -> if error>0.5% rollback -> notify #incidents -> escalate to oncall```

zoe (cs): From CS: two customers (FinCo, Acme) have asked for regional pinning + audit logs. They want guaranteed residency for specific routes. We should add a contractual checkbox for residency and legal signoff.

miguel (eng): Tech caveat: strict residency + affinity increases bin-packing pressure. Need to surface expected worst-case GPU footprint for pilot customers and cost delta. I'll run a sizing estimate if product confirms target list.

elaine (pm): Action: I'll add a prioritization matrix to the doc — columns: customer, SLA tier, residency required (Y/N), revenue signal, migration complexity. Please annotate.

samir (arch): For routing policies, propose a compact DSL example so product can reason about policy permutations. e.g.:
```
route {
  match: customer_id == "Acme" -> region_preference: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: region: global, model_variant: gpt-4-mini
}
```

miguel (eng): +1 to DSL. Also calling out autoscale constraints: max-burst-per-tenant and soft-eviction thresholds. Need product to pick default values or we'll default to conservative settings (higher cost).

elaine (pm): Proposed guardrails (draft):
- Launch gate: 99.5% regional success rate over a 24h pilot
- Cost cap per-tenant for pilot (PM to approve)
- Security: KMS key in-region if residency required
- Ops: documented rollback and runbook in Console
If anyone objects to those buckets speak now.

zoe (cs): +1. Add customer comms template for 'routing onramp' — we should set expectations around failover and potential transient latency.

nina (sre): Will draft the runbook and tie to alert thresholds. Also adding synthetic checks for cross-region fallback verification.

miguel (eng): I’ll sketch the sizing and quantify token costs with/without affinity for 3 sample customers. ETA: Tue.

elaine (pm): Great — final ask: product owners pls add customer rows to the matrix by EOD Mon. We'll use that to run the prioritization exercise Wed sync. Thanks all :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/routing-policy-dsl v0.1 -> staging (triggered by samir).

samir (arch): small note: tie DSL v0.1 to telemetry events so Console can show 'policy hit' counts. Without that it's hard to measure econ impact.

elaine (pm): noted — adding telemetry as dependency. I'll follow up with a short doc update.
